zh-CN.title: 知识空间与连接
zh-CN.description: 组织知识空间、连接与成员权限，让团队按授权范围使用资料。

usage.title: 由管理员配置空间与资源
usage.description: 通过平台管理接口配置连接、空间成员和可访问资源，明确操作权限。

usage.title: 在授权范围内使用
usage.description: 通过知识中心或平台接口选择可访问的空间和知识库，再进行导入与状态查询。

requirements: 已安装知识入库与处理扩展，并配置连接、持久化存储和空间策略。

en-US.title: Knowledge spaces and connections
en-US.description: Organize knowledge spaces, connections and membership for authorized access.

usage.title: Configure spaces and resources
usage.description: An administrator configures connections, space membership, accessible resources and permitted operations through the platform API.

usage.title: Work within an authorized space
usage.description: Use Knowledge center or platform APIs to select an accessible space and knowledge base, then ingest content or inspect processing.

requirements: Install the knowledge management extension and configure connections, persistent storage and space policies.
